modules_note: sympy is ABSENT in this environment. H-SMTH-001.test_boundary.implementation anticipated 'sympy 1.14.0 for factorization'; the frozen contract EXP-SMTH-71b1b0 names no library. The driver therefore implements complete factorisation in pure Python (trial division, deterministic Miller-Rabin, Pollard-Brent). Recorded as a deviation, not concealed. No package was installed: budget.no_network is true.

git.dirty_tree_detail: Two untracked paths at run time, both produced by this task and both inside its exclusive write scope. No tracked file was modified. The frozen specification.yaml is unmodified and its sha256 was re-verified at run start.

sources.name: SHA256 counter-mode DRBG
sources.note: Fully deterministic. No os.urandom, no system entropy, no clock, no unseeded random module anywhere in a generative path.

randomness_sources.pollard_brent_parameters: derived deterministically from the integer being factored (sha256 of its bytes), so every factorisation is reproducible

resource_limits_applied_in_each_stage.note: RSS <= virtual address space, so an AS cap at the contract peak-RSS ceiling is a kernel-enforced hard guarantee.

network.note: No socket, urllib, http or requests module is imported by any file in experiments/EXP-SMTH-71b1b0/implementation/.

inference.fallback_reason: Run under the Claude Code harness, which cannot resolve the policy aliases in orchestration/model-policies.yaml; the actual resolved model is recorded directly per the CLAUDE.md model policy note. Never silently substituted.
inference.model_verified_note: python3 -m orchestration.adapter doctor --probe was not run in this session, so this is false rather than assumed.
inference.note: The inference stack performed no part of the measurement. Every number in raw-result.json is produced by deterministic Python, reproducible from the recorded command and revision without any model.

artifact_digests_note: Digests of every artifact of this run package and of every implementation file, captured after the manifest and implementation notes were written. environment.json itself is excluded because it carries this list; nothing in manifest.yaml records environment.json's own digest, so there is no circular pin.

reproducibility.why_not: budget.maximum_runs is 1. A second full invocation would be a second run of a contract that authorizes one.
reproducibility_established_instead_by: CTRL-APPARATUS-IDENTITY: the driver re-derived the curve, the factor base and the complete null integer stream from the frozen seed inside the same run and reproduced every stream digest at both field sizes.

verify_run.py (separate process, shares no code with the driver): re-derived p, a, b, #E and the factor-base sha256 independently at both field sizes; re-factored 2398 sampled records by pure trial division and reproduced every recorded largest prime factor; recomputed KS2-DS-1, TAIL-DS-1, DECAY-1, RATE-DS-1 and KS-DS-1 from the dumped arrays and matched the reported values.
The six arms/*.lpf.i64 dumps carry every largest prime factor, so any third party can recompute every statistic without re-running the measurement.
